title: An authentication token is created and returned under the same rules as a conversation token

provenance.quote: A client agent or server agent may create a submessage with the format field of 'token' and the subformat field beginning with 'authentication'. ... The other end-point is obligated to return the authentication token unmodified so that authentication can be performed seamlessly.

notes: §6.2.2 adds no echo rule of its own: it names a subformat prefix, says the creator must be able to translate the token back into credentials, and leaves the returning to §6.2. So the only thing that distinguishes this case from `ecma-430/32` is which switch is on and which prefix appears — which is exactly the claim being recorded. "Anonymous mode" in TR/113 §10 is this: the end-point issues a credential to a peer that presented none.
